blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — Bohol Gov. Erico Aristotle Aumentado on Monday, Oct. 5, ordered the police to swiftly identify and arrest the suspects who robbed two Chinese tourists at a popular tourist spot in Loay town. Aumentado directed Bohol Provincial Police Office director Col. Patricio Degay Jr. to immediately investigate the robbery and ensure the suspects are brought to justice. The governor stressed the need to protect the safety and security of visitors to Bohol, particularly tourists exploring the province’s various destinations. “No visitor should be abused or fall victim to criminality while visiting Bohol,” Aumentado said.
